title: DoodyCalls
tagline: Efficiency and sustainability in pet waste management solutions
summary: Backend and frontend features for a pet waste management and operations platform: Django APIs, React dashboards, filtering and exports, and automated report delivery via S3 and email.
overview: A pet waste management and operations platform for a US business. I built features across the stack to support day-to-day operational workflows and reporting.
The biggest win was automation: reports are generated, uploaded to Amazon S3 and emailed automatically, removing a recurring manual task for the operations team.

points: Built REST APIs and backend features with Django and PostgreSQL to support operational workflows.
Developed responsive UI components with React.js, Redux and Ant Design.
Implemented reporting, data filtering and export functionality.
Built workflows that generate reports and upload them to Amazon S3.
Implemented email automation for report distribution.

achievements: Reduced manual reporting effort through automated report generation and delivery.
